node.statement: Independence check: retain the registered level-one pairing and every algebraic operation, but at one level n>=2 interpret the amplified sesquilinear form as <Y,V>_n^prime:=2*sum_i<Y_i,V_i>. This changes none of def-ha-map, def-hcb-datum, or the amplified-compression dependency as presently registered, yet the derived scalar sum is <Y,V>_n^prime/2 rather than <Y,V>_n^prime. Therefore the missing coordinate-sum normalization is logically necessary; it cannot be supplied by finite distributivity or by node 1.3.1.
